title: Velo Client 0.8.4: World Map, Skins & a lot more
summary: A full world map, a skin changer with 3D previews, Shulker Preview, Better F3, spawn & simulation radius spheres, news and polls in the launcher, and one-click bug reports.

blocks.text: This is one of our biggest updates yet. Here's everything that's new - and thanks to everyone who sent ideas!

Press **M** to open a full-screen map of everywhere you've explored. Drag to move, scroll to zoom, and switch between **Surface**, **Topography**, **Biomes** and **Caves**. Your waypoints and death points show up on it, and right-click anywhere to add a new waypoint.
Streaming? You can hide coordinates and biome names on the map in the World Map module settings.

Save skins by **username, UUID or PNG** and switch with one click - in the launcher (profile page) or in game under *Options > Skin Customization > Velo Skins*. Every skin is shown in 3D, and your current skin is always the first card.
Hold **Shift** over a shulker box or bundle to see what's inside. Press **Ctrl+Shift** to open it right next to your inventory and move items in and out (singleplayer and the Creative inventory).

blocks.caption: Ctrl+Shift: take items out and put items in

blocks.text: A cleaner debug screen with compact, see-through panels. It also shows the matching **Nether / Overworld coordinates** for building portals, and you can switch off every row you don't need. Open **Edit HUD Layout** and press **F3** to drag and resize the F3 panels like any other HUD element.
See exactly where mobs can spawn and despawn around you (24 / 32 / 128 blocks) as spheres in your own colors, plus the area your server actually simulates - read from the server, not your settings.

items: **Boss Bar module** - move, scale or hide boss bars (with an example bar in the HUD editor)
**Hitbox Visualizer** - separate colors for players, hostile mobs, passive mobs, projectiles and items
**New R-Shift menu** - every feature in one tidy menu, with Edit HUD Layout right next to search
**Custom advancements screen** - tree and list view, search and progress per tab
**Velo screens** - switch the Velo Advancements, Controls or Statistics screens back to vanilla in Settings
**Mouse Buttons** - the mouse style now shows middle clicks, with your CPS right inside each button
**Mod browser hints** - mods whose feature Velo already has (world maps, auto reconnect, shulker tooltips, zoom...) are marked "Built into Velo"

blocks.text: You're reading this in the new **News** tab! We'll post every update here, and you can **vote in polls** on what we build next.

Found a bug? Press **Report a bug** in the pause menu - or, if the game crashed, we'll offer to send the crash report next time. You can add a note about what happened, and you can see exactly what gets sent.

items: Pressing Back on the advancements screen no longer reopens it
Old 64x32 skins now show both arms correctly
Skin cards and toolbars no longer overlap on small windows
Changing skins several times in a row no longer gets stuck on "Uploading..."
The account picture in the launcher sidebar updates after a skin change
The News tab no longer stays highlighted after switching tabs

blocks.text: Update through the Velo launcher - your settings and HUD layout carry over.
